name: com.allstacks/allstacks-mcp
title: Allstacks Analytics MCP Server
description: Provides 194+ tools for AI-native engineering intelligence via Allstacks API. Supports Bearer token (PAT) or HTTP Basic authentication.

ALLSTACKS_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for Bearer auth (recommended; required for SSO-only users). Alternative: use ALLSTACKS_USERNAME + ALLSTACKS_PASSWORD for HTTP Basic auth.

ALLSTACKS_USERNAME.description: Username or email for HTTP Basic Auth (only for local accounts, not SSO). Requires ALLSTACKS_PASSWORD. Alternative: use ALLSTACKS_TOKEN for Bearer auth.

ALLSTACKS_PASSWORD.description: Password for HTTP Basic Auth (only for local accounts, not SSO). Requires ALLSTACKS_USERNAME. Alternative: use ALLSTACKS_TOKEN for Bearer auth.

ALLSTACKS_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for Allstacks API (default: https://app.allstacks.com/api/v1/)
